# Salesforce Marketing Cloud

Salesforce is a global cloud computing company that develops CRM solutions and provides business software on a subscription basis.

Contact Orange Logic


Solution Type

[Creative](https://marketplace.orangelogic.com/t/solution-type/creative)

[Email](https://marketplace.orangelogic.com/t/solution-type/email)

## Orange Logic and Salesforce Marketing Cloud

The Orange Logic connector for Salesforce Marketing Cloud enables marketers to meet the growing demand for content and bring campaigns to market faster that are on brand, elevate your brand experiences and drive business impact.

**Benefits**

- Streamline the content lifecycle in one solution: creation, collaboration, approval, management, and distribution.
- Approved assets are easily accessible for direct use in Salesforce Marketing Cloud.
- Pull multiple variations of an asset from OrangeDAM for A/B testing within Salesforce Content Builder, improving campaign performance and content effectiveness.
- Find relevant assets quickly with powerful user permissions, metadata, and searching.
- Faceted and full-text search makes it easy to find just the right asset to personalize campaigns, maximize impact, and drive conversions.

## Salesforce Marketing Cloud + Orange Logic Key Features

- Drag and drop the Orange Logic content block into your SFMC email templates
- Search, browse, filter and select assets from OrangeDAM directly within Salesforce Marketing Cloud.
- OrangeDAM metadata and security policies ensure SFMC users only have access to approved content
- Select the original or optimized asset.
- Faceted and full-text search makes it easy to find just the right asset to personalize campaigns, maximize impact, and drive conversions.
